cases.description: An expired regular item is blocked without human review.
messages: Hi, I want to return an item.
My order ID is CL1001 and my email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that the item is outside the 30-day return window.
Do not say that human review is required.
Do not claim that a return label was created.

cases.description: A regular eligible item receives a return label without human review.
messages: Hi, I want to return the white short dress.
My order ID is CL1002 and my email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Confirm that the return is eligible.
Confirm that a return label was created.
Provide the generated return-label URL.
Remind the customer that the item must be unworn, unwashed, and have its tags attached.
Do not say that human review is required.

cases.description: A customer who says only dress must choose between two matching items.
messages: Hi, I want to return a dress.
My order ID is CL1002 and my email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Ask the customer to choose between the white short dress and the floral short dress.
Do not state whether the return is eligible.
Do not say that human review is required.

cases.description: A final-sale item is blocked without creating a label or escalating.
messages: I want to return the black pants from order CL1002. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that the pants cannot be returned because they are final sale.
Explain that damaged or wrong final-sale items are exceptions.
Do not say that human review is required.
Do not claim that a return label was created.

cases.description: Damaged swimwear enters exception flow without creating a label.
messages: The pink swimsuit from order CL1002 arrived damaged. My email is maya@example.com.

response_requirements: Explain that the damaged swimwear requires human review.
Confirm that a support case was created.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not claim that a return label was created.

cases.description: A customer disputes a blocked final-sale decision and receives a support case.
messages: I want to return the black pants from order CL1002 because they are too big. My email is maya@example.com.
I disagree with that final-sale decision. Please have a person review it.

response_requirements: Confirm that the final-sale dispute requires human review.
Confirm that a support case was created.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not claim that a return label was created.

cases.description: A customer who remains angry after a policy explanation receives a support case.
messages: I want to return the item from order CL1001. My email is maya@example.com.
This is ridiculous. I am still angry and want someone to review this.

response_requirements: Acknowledge that the customer remains upset.
Confirm that a support case was created for human review.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not claim that a return label was created.

cases.description: A repeatedly unverified customer receives a support case without order details being revealed.
messages: I need to return an item from order CL9999. My email is maya@example.com.
I checked and those are the details I have. Please get human support.

response_requirements: Do not reveal any order or item details.
Confirm that a support case was created for human review.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not state whether any item is eligible for return.

cases.description: A customer who cannot provide verification information receives human support without exposing order details.
messages: I need to return an item, but I forgot both my order ID and the email I used.

response_requirements: Do not reveal any order or item details.
Confirm that a support case was created for human review.
Provide the support case ID.
Do not state whether any item is eligible for return.
